data.description:
## Incident Overview

Commit af07466226 (Bug 5126-dc68) deliberately demoted dispatch.py:_make_synthetic_error from severity='critical' to severity='important' so the pipeline-internal schema_error becomes eligible for autonomous R5 resolution. The corresponding tests in tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py were not updated and still assert severity='critical'.

### Failing tests (5 of 670)
- test_correction_count_drift_routes_to_synthetic_error
- test_correction_frozen_field_mutation_routes_to_synthetic_error
- test_correction_exhausted_retries_appends_synthetic_error
- test_valid_finding_id_mutation_rejected
- test_file_and_cited_lines_frozen_field_mutation_rejected

Reproduced locally against origin/main: tests fail with 'AssertionError: Synthetic error severity must be critical, got: important'. Same failure observed on PR #143 CI (job 76324158820) where my unrelated fix branch picked it up via the main merge.

### Resolution
Update the 5 assertions and the docstring at the top of the test file from 'critical' to 'important' to match the deliberate intent of commit af07466226. Applied as part of PR #143 to unblock auto-merge.

### Workflow Step
Python Skill/Doc Tests CI job → make test-python-skills
data.title: [dso_ci_review/dispatch]: severity demotion critical->important not propagated to tests -> Python Skill/Doc Tests fail on main
